name: Limit 168
source:
You have arrived on a mysterious island with no memories. Searching for something that helps you remember, you meet a group of lonely girls...

[based on [url=http://densetsu.com/display.php?id=400&style=alphabetical]Anime Densetsu[/url]]
translation:
你失去记忆，来到一座神秘岛屿。寻找能够唤醒往事之物时，你遇见了一群孤独的女孩……
